title: 30A Beach House Dream by The Sea Panhandle Getaways
h1: 30A Beach House Dream by The Sea
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Dream by the Sea, located in Santa Rosa Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 7 bedroom, 7 bathroom vacation home with private pool and all of the conveniences of home. Perfect for large group getaways, families, reunions, weddings, girl’s weekends.
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental, Dream by the Sea, located in Santa Rosa Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 7 bedroom, 7 bathroom vacation home with private pool and all of the conveniences of home. Perfect for large group getaways, families, reunions, weddings, girl’s weekends. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Dream By The Sea is a brand new 5500+ square foot home boasting beautiful balcony views. Designed for luxury and comfort and professionally decorated with a refined Florida ambiance, Dream By The Sea features: an elevator, coral-tiled floors, granite counter tops, top of the line stainless steel appliances, a private pool and 2 car garage with plenty of parking. You have easy access to the beautiful beaches. Located on Scenic 30A, it is convenient to all the best restaurants and shopping. All rooms boast a private bathroom, large closet, and Smart TV; no one has to share. The property is truly optimized for guests enjoyment. Several large outdoor decks provide the opportunity to lounge and enjoy the sunset. Next to the famous restaurant Local Catch, access to the best pizza from the restaurant Pizza by the Sea and enjoy a great lunch or dinner at Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar in the heart of 30A next to Gulf Place FEATURES* 30A Beach House - 7 Bedrooms* Private Pool * Pet Friendly* 3 Floors Enjoy Balconies with Plenty of Seating* Watch Balcony with Gulf View - Fourth Floor * Front Porch* Large Living Area on the Main Level with 65" Smart TV* Second Living Area - Third Floor* Additional Kitchen with Sink, Ice Maker, Refrigerator and Microwave - Third Floor* Fully Equipped Chef's Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Sitting Area, 52" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Main Level* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, 52" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Second Floor* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Second Floor* Bedroom 4 - 2 Bunk Beds (6 Twins) 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Second Floor* Bedroom 5 - King Bed, 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Third Floor* Bedroom 6 - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Third Floor* Bedroom 7 - 2 Bunk Beds (6 Twins) 42" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - Third Floor* Living Area - Full Sleeper Sofa - Main Level* Elevator* Back Patio with Plenty of Seating * Outdoor Kitchen Kitchen with Gas Grill and Sink* Outdoor Shower* Laundry Room with Full Size Washer and Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 24 Pool may be heated for an additional fee of $50.00 per day. Complimentary use of the Electric Vehicle Charger on site: All Major Brands, Tesla, Nissan, Toyota, GM , BMW vehicles and many more. Surveillance Devices on Property: Front door Nest doorbell camera, Back Patio Grilling Area, Outside Stairs Area, Outside Front Driveway, Top Over Watch Balcony 4th Floor Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLY WITH STIPULATIONSWe welcome well-trained dogs up to 45lbs to stay in this home. We require that your dog be completely potty trained and prefer dogs older than 2 years old. Crate Trained pups are preferred to deter mischievous behavior while you and your party are enjoying the beach. It is understood that while we do allow dogs with the mentioned stipulations any damages that occur during your stay will be charged to the credit card on file with the minimum fee being $350.00. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
Pool / Spa / Hot Tub: Private Pool - Heated for an Additional Fee
